name: Waldorf Astoria Cairo Heliopolis
positioning: Waldorf Astoria hotel in Heliopolis, Cairo, with four bars and restaurants, a spa, an outdoor pool and a Grand Ballroom
best_for: Travelers who want a Heliopolis base in Cairo
Guests hosting large events in the Grand Ballroom
Guests who enjoy afternoon tea and a jazz bar

facts.text: The hotel is on Orouba Street in Heliopolis, Cairo.
The hotel is in Heliopolis and is easily accessible to Cairo's landmarks.
The hotel has four on-site bars and restaurants.
Brasserie Ayda serves an eclectic Mediterranean menu.
Rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows.
Room types include a King Premier Room with Balcony and Pool View.
The hotel has a spa and a fitness center.
The Grand Ballroom can host up to 1,600 guests.

highlights.text: Peacock Lounge pays tribute to the original Peacock Alley at the Waldorf Astoria New York.
Rosetta Club rooms and suites include access to the Rosetta Club, with complimentary drinks throughout the stay.
Bar Raa is a jazz bar.
Le Jardin Pool Bar serves mixology creations and light meals.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the hotel is in the Heliopolis suburb rather than central Cairo's historic areas.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the Waldorf Astoria positioning.
